embed:rst RabbitFX on this component, carried across with the SOURCE's routing :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` RabbitFX patches a character's pixel shaders to take a mod's maps (``Resource\\RabbitFX\\Diffuse``, ``...Lightmap``, ``...Normalmap``, ...) in place of the shader's first texture samples. Which map replaces which sample is decided per draw from the KIND of texture bound at ``ps-t0`` .. ``ps-t3`` when the mod runs ``CommandList\\RabbitFX\\SetTextures`` -- as of RabbitFX 8.3.2, its ``filter_index`` 1718.3 (a square BC7 of more than 10 mips, or a small square B8G8R8A8 with mips), 1718.4 (a square R8 with mips, or a large square BC7 of one mip), 1718.5 (a 1 x 1 B8G8R8A8) or 1718.6 (a square BC7 of at most 512 and 10 mips). On the target those registers hold other files (the fix's edits, other formats), so the same mod lines route the maps differently. With this set, the component keeps the mod's RabbitFX lines (:cpp:member:`removedRegs` stops removing them here), and right after each ``SetTextures`` the routing flags (``x187`` .. ``w187``) are pinned to what they are on the SOURCE's own draw: read off the mod's own file for the role at each register, or :cpp:member:`gameTags` where the mod binds none. Valid only where the target slot samples the same roles in the same order as the source's pass. **Default**: none, RabbitFX's lines are removed as :cpp:member:`removedRegs` says
